name: hc_lanes_ref-r4-COMMIT
purpose: el1011-hbm-hcvm/hc round 4: HARD LANE-GROUP LEAF ot_hdc_v41x_hcp_lanes (8 FP32 MAC lanes, mul LAT 8 / add LAT 7, pin-flopped inputs = the stage's old input registers, registered outputs) of the HC bank tile (TLG 8 -> 4 leaves per tile, 8 tiles per die). Structural fix for hc_tile-sys-faa39cbe9-{a,b} EARLY_FAIL_HOLD (one clock root over ~57k sinks, FF insertion 415..765 ps, CTS hold stuck at -165/-247 ps in u_mul pipes; textbook REFUSE > 15k sinks). Benches: HC unit SYS composition (exact + MUT_MP/MUT_POST fail) built on these leaves.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN --top-module ot_hdc_v41x_hcp_lanes rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_hcp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.01 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hc_lanes_ref/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hc_lanes_ref/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hc_lanes_ref --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hdc_v41x_hcp_lanes  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
